method: Each candidate considered independently. Turret heads use complete yaw cylinders separately for every occupied Y layer; gun envelope encloses full yaw, analytic pitch extrema and zero/full recoil. Arc parts use fixed occupied-vertex bounds. Test static exact cuboids and production Dog/Roller/Moth occupied-part poses at every1-unit route distance and endpoints. Conservative envelopes may reject a harmless pose; no simultaneous-neighbour compatibility is claimed.
